title: CAS-07152 — The Brendan O'Connor Show — RTÉ Radio 1
text:
Programme: The Brendan O'Connor Show
Broadcast / VOD service: RTÉ Radio 1
Date broadcast or accessed: 21.02.2026
Statute and/or regulatory code: Section 46J(1)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Short description: This edition of the programme featured an interview with the former Executive Director of the World Health Organisation about his life and career. The complaint alleges the omission of relevant public health information and ongoing risks regarding Covid-19 may be regarded as causing harm as it may influence public understanding and behaviour.
Outcome: Dismissed
Commission Decision: Dismiss the complaint pursuant to section 48(4)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 21.05.2026
